faqs.question: What is the fees of BPharma in Jiwaji University?
faqs.answer:
Candidates who get admission to the BPharma programme at Jiwaji University Gwalior must pay the Jiwaji University BPharma fees of INR 93,100. Apart from this, the application fees of INR 1,000 (INR 800 for SC/ ST/ OBC candidates) together with INR 200 registration fees has to be paid through MP Online. For every course, the registration fee of INR 200 per course/ subject has to be paid along with the application fees of INR 1,000 at the kiosk centre. 
Note: This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

college_info.intro:
Candidates willing to get admission to various courses must take part in the Jiwaji University Gwalior admission process. It offers popular programmes such as MBA for 2 years and BSc for 3 - 4 years, depending on the specialisations opted for.
Jiwaji University offers BSc with 150+ specialisations and tuition fees of INR 16 K- 4.24 Lakh. Whereas, courses such as MBA is offered in full-time mode with various specialisations, with an annual intake of 1846 students (all the affiliated colleges combined). MBA fees in Jiwaji University Gwalior include tuition fees ranging from INR 39 K to INR 1.3 Lakh. Apart from that, Jiwaji Vishwavidyalaya Gwalior offers courses such as BCA with 20+ specialisations in full-time mode with tuition fees of INR 25 K - INR 2.58 Lakh.
As per the placement record of MBA graduates, an average package of INR 2.9 Lakh to INR 4.8 Lakh was recorded by the University placement stats. While BSc graduates received an average package of INR 1.4 Lakh to INR 2 Lakh. Admission to any of these courses is conducted based on merit and respective entrance exam scores.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. (Hons.) in Mass Communication - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: This is very good, and it will help many students.

review_content.Placements: 40 percent of students got placed. The lowest package is around 1.5 LPA. The highest package is 4 LPA in many companies. It is a good college. Many students got internships. Many roles are offered by this degree in recruiting companies. The placement is increasing next year.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is very good. The environment is best. The surroundings are also good. The environment of teachers is also very good. The student culture is also very good. College is a very high society, and a good ground for an activity area.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with my college because of its good facilities, good placement and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: 70% of students are placed in my courses. The highest package is about 18 LPA, and the average package is about 7 LPA. About 60% students got internships from my course. Top roles offered in my course. Many technical companies give placement for technical and skilled students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are well managed. Wi-Fi facilities are available. Labs are maintained. Libraries' facilities also provide. Hostel facilities also provide students with all the things. Good quality food is available in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities are also available in my college in emergency situations.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Good faculty but lack of laboratory facilities.

review_content.Placements: Many courses in the university offer placements, but in the pharmacy department, there are no placements. Also, if someone wants an internship during their four years of Bachelor’s, they have to arrange it on their own because there is no support from the department or faculty members.
review_content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure is good. The library is efficient, and the classrooms are also good, but there is a lack of laboratory facilities. Hostel facilities are favorable for girls, as there are two hostels in the university, one is Lakshmi Bai and the other is Mrignayini Girls Hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Jiwaji University is an average university.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements here. Students study on their own. The highest percentage is 90 percent. This university doesn’t provide any kind of internship, and no company comes to the college for placements. They only give permission to go for internships, which we have to arrange on our own.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many courses available in Jiwaji University. Some are good, and some are average. Sometimes, there are no classes in many departments. There are four hostels in Jiwaji University, two hostels for boys and the other two for girls. That’s good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty members and placement.

review_content.Placements: Talking about the percentage of students who are placed, nearly who appear in placement get an award 80 percent. The highest package offered by our college is 15 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. Average package offered is 6 LPA. There are many top recruiters like Bajaj Financial, so every student gets internships from my course, and companies are well-reputed as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is good. Facilities are very good. There are cafeteria and Amul. There are three libraries. Very good classroom is there with VR vs unit. Wi-Fi is observable. Labs are also available. The food at the mess is good. Medical facilities and sports are good in our college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It's an average college, good for sports-related students.

review_content.Placements: As I have seen our seniors in college, they have got quite good job opportunities. As of now, I have not been promoted to that stage where I can get an internship, but I have seen that our seniors have good opportunities here. The top roles offered in the course are data analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: Not too much good or not too much, we have an average classroom. In addition, we have separated everything here in college, but not in our classroom. The classroom only has a blackboard with chalk and dusters. For computer classes, we have an additional laboratory, and for everything, we have a good number of sources available here.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Truth reality of MBM University Jodhpur.

content.Placements: There are lots of opportunities for placements on college campus but many students prefer off-campus opportunities compared to on-campus. If I want to say there are 8 LPA average package. Basically, in our college, placements depend largely on students.
content.Infrastructure: The college hostel does not provide clean rooms and bathrooms, so hostlers face a lot of problems there, and also, the hostel food is not good. The infrastructure of the college is also very poor. Dirty classrooms, no working fans, and not enough big classrooms.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good for those who know what they are doing and what they want to do in the future.

content.Placements: There is no placement system in our college, no recruitments, no companies, students should do these things on their own, off campus. Those who want placements have to get courses for the field they are interested in, get certificates, build projects, apply to companies, and get a job, with no help from college.
content.Infrastructure: Campus, ground, and classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is only for staff. There are 7-8 labs, each having around 20 computers, classrooms are clean, and they use two smart TV boards in each class, a library is available, and course-related and field-related books are available. The college only has a girls' hostel with very few seats, around 50 maybe. Sports events are organized as per JNVU. No sports are conducted.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good ROI and decent IT jobs.

content.Placements: Placement rate is 55-70 percent. The highest package is 20.71 LPA, the average package is 6.5 LPA-7.6 LPA, and the median package is 6.8 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA-5 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Capgemini, Wipro, Adani, Vedanta, L&T, Airtel, Tata Steel, Bosch, and BEL. Most students receive internships in varied companies. Top roles are software roles and core engineering roles.
content.Infrastructure: Good overall with smart classrooms, labs, library, and research space, but some equipment is outdated. Separate hostels are available. Girls' hostels are usually better maintained. Boys' hostels are equipped with basic facilities. In the mess and canteen, the average food quality& canteen exist, but it isn't outstanding. Basic medical centre on campus and sports fields, and indoor blocks for activities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: You can also join this college, which has really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: There are many different courses for students that they need. There are many students studying in our college. Minimal fees for all courses. The courses are B.A., B.Com, M.A., etc. You can also choose the subject of your choice. If 80% above, we also get a scholarship from our college.
content.Infrastructure: There are very big classes for different courses. The beautiful environment and facilities are also good. We also have a library in our college with a peaceful environment to study. Sports and games facility also. There is a beautiful garden in our college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is 7/10 good in facilities, moderate placements in the last year, so 5/10 in placements.

content.Placements: Government college Sojat City offers placement about 50% to 60% for the course B.Sc. The highest package offered varies between 10 and 12 LPA. The lowest is around 4 to 5 LPA, and the average is about 6 to 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies for B.Sc. are Infosys, TCS, IBM, UltraTech Cement, Adobe, L&T, etc. An internship is not specified in this course. Top roles in B.Sc. mathematics include data scientist, statistician, financial analyst, etc.
content.Infrastructure: This college doesn't have a hostel. The laboratory, library, and classrooms are well maintained, and the infrastructure is almost good. This college gives you many opportunities to participate in sports and games. There is no canteen in it. There are well-cleaned bathrooms and a fridge. As it is a Government college, it is good in my opinion.

There are 7-8 labs, each having around 20 computers, classrooms are clean, and they use two smart TV boards in each class, a library is available, and course-related and field-related books are available. The college only has a girls' hostel with very few seats, around 50 maybe. Sports events are organized as per JNVU. No sports are conducted.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 17 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good curriculum and decent infrastructure.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 17 Sep 2025)

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 16 Sep 2025)

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 16 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided to the department. AC labs and well-furnished classrooms are available to all departments. Hostels are in good condition for girls but for boys they are just fine. Mess is provided. But sports and games are not provided for hostels.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 16 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with good faculty members and excellent support.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not that much good as it is an old architecture. Ethernet cables and AC labs are provided to us for our department. We also get a library. We have different hostels for different years. Wi-Fi is also provided to us this year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Reality of MBM College Jodhpur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is very old, with water leakage in many areas. Wi-Fi is not available in the college. reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Real truth about MBM University.

Hostel life is good, not bad. Mess food is normal, not as good as, but you can survive, and quality is medium. The hostel rooms are old and need to be replaced with new hostel rooms for boys as well.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by MBM Engineering CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The condition of the MBM College.
reviews.review_text: On a college campus, the infrastructure is quite old, Wi-Fi is not working properly, lab instruments are not working in condition, the library has books, but those books are very old and are of no use now. admission_process.title: Tumkur University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Tumkur University admissionfor PG programmes is both merit-based as well as entrance-based, depending upon the programme. For MCA and MBA, admission is done on the basis of score obtained inKarnataka PGCET, conducted by Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA). For PhD, admission is strictly entrance-based, followed by an interview.Tumkur Universityhas 12 departments and two consequent colleges. The university department offers PG and PhD courses in fields such as Arts, Science, Commerce and Management.

Tumkur University offers many PG courses as base courses, i.e., they do not have specialisations and are offered as base courses. The final selection criteria for these courses is just like all other PG courses. The table below mentions the eligibility criteria of all these courses offered at the university:
Common Eligibility
Selection Criteria
Candidates must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant field with minimum 45% aggregate from a recognised university
Merit-based
Candidates must hold a BCA degree with minimum 50% aggregate from a recognised university
KCET/ Karnataka PGCET/ KMAT
Candidates must hold a BCom/ BCom (CS)/ BBA/ BBM from a recognised university with atleast 50% aggregate
Merit-based
Candidates must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant field with minimum 50% aggregate from a recognised university

Tumkur university fees is a sum of multiple components, such as tuition fee, security deposit, hostel fee, mess fee, and more. Some of these fee components, such as the security fee are one-time chargeable. Candidates need to pay tuition fee semester-wise. Below is the fee forTumkur University courses:
Total Tuition Fee (Investment)

Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.
The seat intake varies course-wise. Candidates can get a seat in Tumkur University based on their merit or state-level entrance exam. Below is course-wise seat intake:
Seat Intake
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Tumkur University admission process includes multiple-steps such as registration, selection and fee payment. Candidates are selected based on entrance exam or merit in the last qualifying exam. Below are the steps to get a seat in Tumkur University:
STEP 1: Tumkur University Application Process 2025
Candidates need to apply online on the official website Department of Collegiate Education. Aspirants will need to provide the university code and other college and course related details.
STEP 2: Selection
The university selects candidates for MSW and MCom based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. For MBA and MCA, the scores in KMAT, Karnataka PGCET and KMAT are considered for admission.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the selection process is over, candidates are called for document verification. Selected candidates need to pay theTumkur University feeto confirm their seats in the university.

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied with the choice I made by choosing ISSM Business School.
reviews.review_text: We have 2 campuses in Chennai with advanced learning technologies and internet access. The campuses are very hygienic and clean with proper necessities. Also, we have a library with famous and must-read management and self-help books. The sports room continues sports like snooker. Carrom helps to learn sportsmanship in professional setting with a blend of fun elements.

reviews.review_heading: Briefing about ISSM Business School.
reviews.review_text: We have two campuses across Chennai. Campus 1 is located at Venkateswara Colony, Taramani. Campus 2 is located on the first floor of ALG Towers, Perungudi. Note: Campus 1 is the main standalone campus with 3 floors, but Campus 2 is a new campus. All facilities are available at both campuses. There are no hostels or medical support. Yes, there is a sports room in C1.

reviews.review_heading: Best College for students who are focusing on a practical-based MBA programme.
reviews.review_text: ISSM Business School provides high-speed internet with good coverage, and they also have good sports facilities. ISSM Business School is not only about studies, but they also have many extracurricular activities and help us gain more knowledge with good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with placements and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: College does not have hostel but they give suggestions to the nearby PGs which is great. Course gives students great exposure over a period of time which gives great learning in English, improves communication, and helps students to motivate them.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the teaching and placements.
reviews.review_text:
In ISSM, Wi-Fi facilities are available on each and every floor.
They provide separate PG for both boys and girls; in the canteen, they provide different dishes every day; and the ISSM conducts indoor and outdoor sports every month for the benefit of students .

reviews.review_heading: The best place to study MBA is ISSM to get a bright future.
reviews.review_text: We have a very good and a hygienic infrastructure. We have a very good library for reference and taking notes. We also have a very good sports room with carrom, chess, table tennis, snookers, and play station.

reviews.review_heading: College that provides great knowledge, placements and memories too.
reviews.review_text: Our facilities were excellent, offering amenities such as Wi-Fi, a sports room, a canteen, and much more. We provided entertainment options like billiards, a carrom board, chess, a PlayStation, and a sound system for relaxation. The canteen served delicious food, and we continuously improved in all aspects. Additionally, we had a dedicated photoshoot room for practicing photography.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian School of Science and Management.
reviews.review_text: ISSM has a four-storey building. The college provides big classrooms equipped with Wi-Fi and AC facilities. They also provide a library and computer lab. It is the first B-school located in theTharamani area. The canteen is on the 4th floor.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good environment.
reviews.review_text: Our college has quite good infrastructure combined with air-conditioning facilities, free Wi-Fi, sports room to play and have fun with your teammates, and library to educate yourself. There is a canteen facility filled with snacks and home-made foods consisting of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Best college and worth every penny.
reviews.review_text: Free unlimited 5G Wi-Fi across the college and a really good playing area. College canteen offers a good homemade food in affordable pricing. There is no seperate hostel in our college since there are lot of Hostels and PGs around our college with good infrastructure providing neat and clean atmosphere and also offering a reasonable food for cost offering.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfying and enjoying our college life to the fullest with great learnings.
reviews.review_text: Our management has free access of 5G Wi-Fi high-speed. And we have individual chair/Desk. We have library. Our college has no hostels. But, in our surroundings there are a lot of good PG's which are very affordable with 3 times food availability, free Wi-Fi, AC and Non AC rooms too. And the especially everything is nearby like beaches, malls, cafes, restaurants etc.

reviews.review_heading: ISSM offers 100% placement.
reviews.review_text: College provides classrooms equipped with Wi-Fi and AC facilities they also providing library, cafeteria. We also have a very good sports room with carrom, chess, table tennis, snookers and play station etc. Basically we collhave good and hygiene infrastructure .

reviews.review_heading: Excellent placement in 2023, attractive atmosphere and well educated faculty members.
reviews.review_text:
Issm business has spacious auditorium which develops the public speaking skills from the students which enhance their upcoming career 
Issm business school has sports room which includes snooker boards, playstation, carrom and library which can be used by students to overcome their stress.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the college that I've decided to do my PG.
reviews.review_text: High-speed internet facility is available for us which helps us to refer online study materials. Self Help Books, Subject related books are available in the play room which are of unique collections. Several Games like Table Tennis, Snookers, PlayStation are available.

reviews.review_text: Good and educational and wonderful? And zo appreciative staffs and hostel wardens and make us feel like home and let me know when you are comfortable and they ask everything that we need so the PPT for teaching make us visually understand everything.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mining Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Really good college, like if you make good friends who hustle and are fun at the same time.

review_content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students got placed in the department of mining engineering. The top recruiting company is Coal India. The highest package is given by Coal India of 40 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. The roles offered are mining engineer, mine planning engineer, drill and blasting engineer, mine surveyor, etc. Almost 30% of the students got internship, in which some got individual internship.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are pretty old and dirty, but are being maintained every year. All the hostels have Wi-Fi with a speed of up to 300 Mbps, and in the curfew hours, like around 10 pm, the speed goes to 30 to 40 Mbps. The campus is clean, but roads are very poorly maintained however, work is underway and will probably be finished in 5 to 6 months. The library is one of the best places with AC and sofas for reading journals and computer desks for studying, and a computer center which will open soon for all the students. Canteens are good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: College gives you all the things regarding academic as well as college life.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 70% of students of the department of civil engineering got placed in prestigious firms as PWC, some PSUs like BHEL, BPCL, and GAIL. The highest package is about 22 LPA, lowest is 6 LPA, and average is 9 LPA - 10 LPA. Top recruiters are PWC, JSW, BPCL, TCS, and many more. About 90% of students got internships, whether paid or non-paid.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good in the department. We have seminar hall, Wi-Fi, labs, and well-equipped classroom. There is also a library. Quality of food offered in hostel is much good. Canteen is available at affordable cost. Medical facilities are also provided by the institute. Sports club and gymnasium are also well-equipped.

review_summary.college_name: IIEST Shibpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Old college yet excels at modern engineering.

content.Placements: Around 80 percent of students got placed from our course. Among them, 15-20 students got more than 20 LPA, and around 50 students got 7 LPA-18 LPA, and the rest got less than 7 LPA. The highest package is 58 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. The recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Texas, Wells Fargo, Synopsis, etc. 40 percent of students got on-campus internships, and overall, 80 percent of students got an internship.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the department is okay, but it needs more space. Labs and libraries are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Hostel infrastructure is bad, and the mess is also not good since this college is very old, the building and toilets have been used for many years without renovation, so it's a bit disappointing, but now they are constructing a new 10-storey 1000-seater boys hostel with a modern look. I hope they increase the quality of the food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Being an IIESTian – through my journey.

content.Placements: Placement statistics of my department (Mechanical Engineering) UG 2025 at IIEST Shibpur. The percentage of students placed is 88.7%. The highest package is 20.00 LPA, the lowest package is 3.3 LPA, and the average package is 7.19 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, PWC, Tata Hitachi, Linde, and Aditya Birla Group. The top roles offered are in the automotive, manufacturing, and consultancy sectors.
content.Infrastructure: In my department, there is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. However, it is available in the library. As IIEST Shibpur is the second oldest engineering college in India, the infrastructure is old but good. Classrooms are very clean and neat, with a good number of fans and lights available. To be frank, the quality of food and water in the hostel is poor. Medical facilities are limited to minor issues, but a health card is provided. All sports and games facilities are available with a good number of opportunities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mining Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good college, like if you make good friends who hustle and are fun at the same time.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students got placed in the department of mining engineering. The top recruiting company is Coal India. The highest package is given by Coal India of 40 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. The roles offered are mining engineer, mine planning engineer, drill and blasting engineer, mine surveyor, etc. Almost 30% of the students got internship, in which some got individual internship.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are pretty old and dirty, but are being maintained every year. All the hostels have Wi-Fi with a speed of up to 300 Mbps, and in the curfew hours, like around 10 pm, the speed goes to 30 to 40 Mbps. The campus is clean, but roads are very poorly maintained however, work is underway and will probably be finished in 5 to 6 months. The library is one of the best places with AC and sofas for reading journals and computer desks for studying, and a computer center which will open soon for all the students. Canteens are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College gives you all the things regarding academic as well as college life.

content.Placements: Approximately 70% of students of the department of civil engineering got placed in prestigious firms as PWC, some PSUs like BHEL, BPCL, and GAIL. The highest package is about 22 LPA, lowest is 6 LPA, and average is 9 LPA - 10 LPA. Top recruiters are PWC, JSW, BPCL, TCS, and many more. About 90% of students got internships, whether paid or non-paid.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good in the department. We have seminar hall, Wi-Fi, labs, and well-equipped classroom. There is also a library. Quality of food offered in hostel is much good. Canteen is available at affordable cost. Medical facilities are also provided by the institute. Sports club and gymnasium are also well-equipped.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Applied Geology - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: Campus placements are excellent 100% placements. Summer placements 2019-20 1.31 LPA (2 months) were offered. In final placements 2018-20 18.76 LPA were offered. Aspirants can go through the placement report of the college for further information. Every student has to go through a summer internship program for 2 months (April-May). The college offers on-campus internship opportunities and many renowned companies visit the campus.
content.Infrastructure: So far we have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects that are physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry. I will opt for physical chemistry as my elective in 2nd year. I am staying in PG and I pay Rs. 6000 per month and the facilities are not very much good but they are just fine to stay. Food is not quality food but it does the job and is better than eating fast food.

reviews.review_heading: Old college yet excels at modern engineering.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the department is okay, but it needs more space. Labs and libraries are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Hostel infrastructure is bad, and the mess is also not good since this college is very old, the building and toilets have been used for many years without renovation, so it's a bit disappointing, but now they are constructing a new 10-storey 1000-seater boys hostel with a modern look. I hope they increase the quality of the food.

reviews.review_heading: Being an IIESTian – through my journey.
reviews.review_text: In my department, there is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. However, it is available in the library. As IIEST Shibpur is the second oldest engineering college in India, the infrastructure is old but good. Classrooms are very clean and neat, with a good number of fans and lights available. To be frank, the quality of food and water in the hostel is poor. Medical facilities are limited to minor issues, but a health card is provided. All sports and games facilities are available with a good number of opport...

reviews.review_heading: Really good college, like if you make good friends who hustle and are fun at the same time.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are pretty old and dirty, but are being maintained every year. All the hostels have Wi-Fi with a speed of up to 300 Mbps, and in the curfew hours, like around 10 pm, the speed goes to 30 to 40 Mbps. The campus is clean, but roads are very poorly maintained however, work is underway and will probably be finished in 5 to 6 months. The library is one of the best places with AC and sofas for reading journals and computer desks for studying, and a computer center which will open soon for ...

reviews.review_heading: College gives you all the things regarding academic as well as college life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good in the department. We have seminar hall, Wi-Fi, labs, and well-equipped classroom. There is also a library. Quality of food offered in hostel is much good. Canteen is available at affordable cost. Medical facilities are also provided by the institute. Sports club and gymnasium are also well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: So far we have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects that are physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry. I will opt for physical chemistry as my elective in 2nd year. I am staying in PG and I pay Rs. 6000 per month and the facilities are not very much good but they are just fine to stay. Food is not quality food but it does the job and is better than eating fast food.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility in the college as the college is located at a prime location of Jabalpur where a lot of coaching classes. Hotels and PGs are available at a very economical rate which we will not find anywhere else. It is small. The hostel facility is the most attractive thing in this institution and I can definitely suggest one who needs the hostel facility to choose this college.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST Shibpur is worth it or not.
reviews.review_text: In first-year classrooms good number of fans and lights are there. They are also very clean and neat but there is no Wi-Fi connection. Labs are also nice. Our hostel buildings are too old, infrastructure is not that good at hostel. Wi-Fi connection is there with good speed. Mess food is decent. Three canteens are there on our campus. Medical facilities are not available (except for everyday and small problems) but they provide health cards. All sports and games facilities are available and good.

reviews.review_heading: About IIEST SHIBPUR formally known as BE college.
reviews.review_text: Library is open every day from 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM except Saturday and Sunday, closing time for Saturday and Sunday is 6:00 PM. Wi-Fi is available in library, a quiet place for study. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, and at least 3 days of non-vegetarian food are given to students. Biryani is given 2 times a month. Infrastructure is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It was the best period of my life to spend such a memorable time there.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good. The library has a high-speed Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are very comfortable, with soundproof walls. The food in the hostel is below average in the first year but gradually improves. Table tennis is available in the hostel. For cricket and football, there are Oval and Lord's grounds.

reviews.review_heading: It is an absolutely amazing college, and I love everything about it.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are really good. Classrooms are air-conditioned, Wi-Fi is available, and the library has a wide range of books. The quality of food in the hostel is okay-ish but eatable. There is a hospital and three canteens inside the campus, and a lot of sports events are happening.

reviews.review_heading: It is the 2nd oldest engineering college and the only IIEST in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good but quite old. It is being constantly renovated. There are around 20 hostels with a 1,000 seater and a 10 storeyed. It already completed its construction. The girls' hostels are particularly large with good food. Boys' hostels are average with average food. The exception is on an occasional basis.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST Shibpur: One of the oldest colleges.
reviews.review_text: All courses in the college are good. There are 10 departments, including the Department of Architecture, all of which are good. Hostel facilities are also good, with 20 hostels providing accommodation for almost all year students, including 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years.

reviews.review_heading: IIEST SHIBPUR Since 1856 - REVIEW.
reviews.review_text: Sports ground available for sports like cricket, basketball, badminton, and football. In each, there is one television, carrom board, and badminton court. Hostel Wi-Fi is also available. There are various labs available for each department, and the quality of food in the hostel is average.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placements, great facilities, and vibrant campus life are available at IIEST Shibpur.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at IIEST Shibpur for B.Tech include Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a vast library with physical and digital resources. Hostels provide basic amenities with moderate cleanliness. The mess offers decent food, and the canteen has additional snacks. It provides sports facilities like grounds for cricket, football, and courts for badminton. Medical care is available through an on-campus dispensary.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur,is the second oldest engineering clg
reviews.review_text: There are a total of three hostels for first-year students at IIEST Shibpur. Hostel 8: This hostel is the oldest among the three. The mess food and sports facilities are better compared to the other two. Hostel 9: This hostel is slightly similar to Hostel 8. Hostel 10: This is a newly built hostel, and its infrastructure is much better in comparison to the others.

review_summary.college_name: RGC - Rajiv Gandhi Group of Institution Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is worth reading in this college. All teachers and staff members are supportive and friendly.

content.Placements: There are around 73 students in our class. The highest salary package offered is about 9 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Around 85% of the students got internships from our course because it is a must and in the final semester it carries marks.
content.Infrastructure: ]Our college has a good infrastructure. There is a small canteen which is near the ground. He prepares all the items which are good for our health and it is hygienic as well. There is no Wi-Fi connectivity in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of RGC - Rajiv Gandhi Group of Institution.

content.Placements: According to my knowledge, 60% of students got placed in computer science and engineering department. The annual package offered was around 1.5 to 3 LPA. Some students got seats through CET. It was around 70,000 for them. There were different branches in engineering, like mechanical, computer science, biomedical, civil engineering etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good. The college has a library, from where we can take books, read them and even take them home. Later, we have to return them. Our classrooms are good. There are many different auditoriums for different branches. Labs are not fully equipped.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I have enjoyed my 4 years in RGIT, and I had the best time on campus.

content.Placements: I was in computer science student, and we had 2 sections. The highest strength is recorded in CSE followed by biomedical engineering. There were no placements in 2020 and 2021. I think it was due to covid-19 situation. Now, there might be placements from this year.
content.Infrastructure: I am a day scholar, but some of my friends are from Kerala. They used to stay in the hostel. They always used to say that the hostel food was bad. Rooms are always clean and have separate restrooms. They had to follow hostel timings, and they were not allowed to go out after 9 pm.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the off-course faculty and their behaviour.

content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placement opportunities. Sometimes, local business people visit the college to hire students. So they don't even conduct any placement drives. Whenever a company visit the college, they just go back without hiring any student. They organise a job fair which is useless, and this is a business trick to make money.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good, but there is no playground. It's difficult to survive in the college for four years. Classrooms and labs are in the worst condition. I suggest you be careful when you choose a college. The equipment in the labs is good, and all the equipment is useless.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied by the Infrastructure of college,Good faculties and average Placements.

content.Placements: Placements for my batch has not yet started. But for my seniors batch the placements was held. And only 5 students were selected out of 60. The highest average salary was offered 3,00000 and the lowest was about 150000. The companies visited our campus for placements are Wipro, Infosys, IBM, and several other companies also. Different kinds of roles were offered to the selected members like Testing, Software development, Web desighee etc. There are no internships given to the students. And there is no proper placement cell in the college. In my opinion placements in our college are not much useful for students. I think in future the placements will be given more and it will be improved.

review_summary.college_name: NM Institute of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average package, not bad infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am pursuing CSE from NMIET. I believe the university provides you with a lot of opportunities as well as exposure. The faculty at NMIET are top notch and dedicated to the careers of students. Students can have doubt sessions with the respective faculties even on Sundays. The placement rate is quite high as the university provides a number of opportunities with many companies and MNCs coming for campus placements and recruiting a large number of students. The university always tries its best to make students work easy by providing study material, mock tests and AMCAT preparation. I hope you achieve your dreams. Only 5 percent of students were placed this year with the highest package being 4 LPA and the average 2 LPA. TCS and Infosys have 10 percent of students getting internships in CSE Mechanical Engineering and MBA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college campus is lucky for me and I am thankful to our teachers.

content.Placements: There are no good placements coming to our college. Good companies visit the college sometimes but the salary offered is less than Rs.30,000 per month. The college charges fees of Rs.75.000 per year. So it is slightly a better campus, and all the departments are good.
content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms are huge and have CCTV cameras and air-conditioned and fans available. The library is small, but all types of books are available. Wi-Fi is enabled on the entire campus, and hostel rooms are good. They serve better food. All types of sports are played in the college. The medical facilities provided are better.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college should provide many facilities.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered is 2 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1 LPA. TCS company recruited many students from our college. Almost 90% of the students from our course got an internship in TCS. A top role offered is a production in charge.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides many facilities like 24 hours free Wi-Fi, a library, air-conditioned classrooms, etc. Our college provides a hostel facility with good and healthy food. The environment is also good. The canteen is neat and clean. Our college provides medical facilities. The medical staff members are very helpful, and they also help us in every situation.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: This college provides good placements and faculty members.

content.Placements: Approximately 80%of the students get placed from our course. The highest salary offered was of Rs. 30,000 per month. TCS, Tech Mahindra and Thomson digital were the top recruiting companies. System engineer and production head were the roles offered. The salary package offered in our course was 10 LPA. Around 75% of the students got an internship in Indian railways and Mitsubishi motors.
content.Infrastructure: The college is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are good. There are two fields in college for sports. The hostel and mess are very good. The quality of the food served is good and not too bad like other colleges. Library and labs are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The college is the best in the city with highly qualified teachers with the good surrounding.

content.Placements: The placement for our batch and our senior batched was average. Almost 40% of students got placed through campus placements. The highest salary package offered was 4.12 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 1.50 LPA. Many companies, like AISS Glasses, Byju's, Delhivery.com, etc., visited our campus for placements. Roles like trainee engineer, team lead, etc., were offered to students. Almost 10% of students got an internship at our college. The highest stipend offered was Rs. 5,000 during the internship. The lowest stipend offered was Rs. 2,000. The average stipend offered was Rs. 3,500. the placement cell in our college is good, which have 40% of efficiency to place students in good company.

reviews.review_text: College is an integral part of the lives of every student. It teaches us some of the best values of life. We gain many experiences and make infinite memories there. Some of the people we meet in college stay with us forever. It helps transition our minds from school to adulthood and teaches us to take responsibility for our lives. SRCC is located in the North Campus and part of the prestigious University of Delhi is extremely special to me. It has a great record of exceptional performance not on...

reviews.review_heading: Our college campus is lucky for me and I am thankful to our teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are huge and have CCTV cameras and air-conditioned and fans available. The library is small, but all types of books are available. Wi-Fi is enabled on the entire campus, and hostel rooms are good. They serve better food. All types of sports are played in the college. The medical facilities provided are better.

reviews.review_heading: Our college should provide many facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides many facilities like 24 hours free Wi-Fi, a library, air-conditioned classrooms, etc. Our college provides a hostel facility with good and healthy food. reviews.review_heading: This college provides good placements and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are good. There are two fields in college for sports. The hostel and mess are very good. The quality of the food served is good and not too bad like other colleges. Library and labs are good.

reviews.review_heading: The college is the best in the city with highly qualified teachers with the good surrounding.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. The Wi-Fi connection needs to be strong. Labs, classrooms, library are in average conditions. Medical facilities and sports and games facilities are very good at our college. The quality of the food served is healthy and hygiene. Hostel rooms are in average conditions. I didn't face any issues regarding the infrastructure of the college during my tenure.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the oldest educational institutes of Odisha, and a great place for students to learn.
reviews.review_text: The campus is huge. The campus environment is quiet eco-friendly and good for studies. It has big classrooms, and the classrooms are digitally equipped with projectors. The college also provides high-tech lab facilities. We have a big auditorium hall for cultural activities. It is located 1.2 km away from AIMS Medical College. We have well-furnished and air-conditioned hostel rooms, and the hostels are heigenic. The food offered in the canteen is good. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Placements were good in 2016, and the college has good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was good. The campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Medical and ambulance services were available. Gym and canteen facilities were available on the campus. The college also has a central library. Separate hostel facilities were available for boys and girls. Classrooms were good. Computer and English labs were air-conditioned. The campus environment was good. The campus also has different sports fields. Our college has good labs and workshops.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good place. Faculty members are friendly, and the facilities provided are good.

They also provide internet connection for every system in the lab.

reviews.review_heading: Not good for students who want a good job.

reviews.review_heading: The college review of NMIET, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

Everything is not useful and only for show-off.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty members were good and supportive.

The infrastructure in the library is not good, and need to build up the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college faculty. They are helpful for every student.

Till now, I didn't face any issues related to these labs, hostel, library, etc. Overall, it is a superb college.

reviews.review_heading: Quality education and fruitful B.Tech life. NMIET should be your 3rd choice after Silicon And GIET.

For different branches, we have different buildings and hostels inside the campus with all the good hygiene facilities. There is a gym on the campus, but I am afraid that it was not a multigym back in 2015, I am not sure about now. I will rate it 7 out of 10 for the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Shows the dream of a sky and then abandons it to the ground.

There was even not enough space for the students for any indoor activities like cricket, etc. Hostel bathrooms were not that cleaned and the concerned authorities did not pay enough attention regarding this.

review_summary.college_name: Apex University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Full Stack - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Apex College in Jaipur is the best option, but for better placement, you can choose another.

content.Placements: I am from the Computer Science batch at Apex College. In our passing-out batch, 85% of students were successfully placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, the lowest is 3.2 LPA, and the average package stands at around 5.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, and Capgemini.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course at Apex College is fairly decent. The classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, though it is sometimes slow. Labs are well-maintained, with the basic software and hardware required for practicals.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Everything went well at the university.

content.Placements: You will get a good placement, along with that, you will be given the facility of an internship from time to time. If you want to increase your knowledge well and you will also get a good package. You can get an LPA package from 2 LPA to 5 LPA from Apex University.
content.Infrastructure: You will be taught and educated in an AC room. There is a computer lab. There is also a library and along with that you are provided with internet facility. The food in the mess is also good. You will also get a canteen in the college. Sports and games are also played.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty and college facilities are good.

content.Placements: The percentage of student placements is around 60% in my course. The highest package is around 9.3 LPA and the lowest is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho. Around 70% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Apex University in Jaipur, Rajasthan offers a wide range of facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, mess, and canteen. It also maintains a hygienic environment around the college campus and is a tobacco-free zone.

individual_reviews.course: B.Ed. Special Education in Intellectual Disability - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: There were 30 seats in my course, and all seats were filled by students. Basically, in this course, there were no placement offers. Teachers trained us on how to teach in schools and child care centers and how to deal with special needs children, so no placement was required for this course.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were well-furnished and equipped. Wi-Fi was available in the library. Hostel food was good in taste and served fresh. The mess and canteen maintained hygiene. Medical facilities were good, and the university organized clubs and tournaments on campus for sports and other activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It's a good college; you can take admission.

content.Placements: Placements for nursing are okay but not something to fully rely on. Most of the time, you have to put in your effort. Apply to hospitals directly, do internships, and build contacts. Some reputed hospitals do visit or offer internships, but it's not super consistent. If you're good with your practicals and take your clinical postings seriously, you will have a better chance. A lot of students either go for higher studies or prepare for government exams after B.Sc. Nursing. So, placements aren't the main focus for everyone.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nothing fancy, just average. The college infrastructure is honestly just okay. Not too bad, but nothing to brag about either. Classrooms are decent; some have projectors, some don't. Labs are usable, but sometimes the equipment is outdated or not well-maintained. The library is there, but don't expect it to be super stocked. Wi-Fi works sometimes. The campus looks fine overall, but maintenance could be better. Hostels are livable but basic; don't go in expecting luxury. Basically, the infrastructure does the job, but it’s not going to blow your mind.

faqs.answer: Apex University, also known as AU, is a private university which was established by Sanjay Shiksha Samiti in 2018 under Act No 27 of Rajasthan State Legislature. It is recognised by the UGC and is approved by the AICTE. The University is also approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI), Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) and National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE). reviews.review_heading: Apex College in Jaipur is the best option, but for better placement, you can choose another.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course at Apex College is fairly decent. The classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, though it is sometimes slow. Labs are well-maintained, with the basic software and hardware required for practicals.

reviews.review_heading: Everything went well at the university.
reviews.review_text: You will be taught and educated in an AC room. There is a computer lab. There is also a library and along with that you are provided with internet facility. The food in the mess is also good. You will also get a canteen in the college. Sports and games are also played.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and college facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Apex University in Jaipur, Rajasthan offers a wide range of facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, mess, and canteen. It also maintains a hygienic environment around the college campus and is a tobacco-free zone.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were well-furnished and equipped. Wi-Fi was available in the library. Hostel food was good in taste and served fresh. The mess and canteen maintained hygiene. Medical facilities were good, and the university organized clubs and tournaments on campus for sports and other activities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college; you can take admission.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nothing fancy, just average. The college infrastructure is honestly just okay. Not too bad, but nothing to brag about either. Classrooms are decent; some have projectors, some don't. Labs are usable, but sometimes the equipment is outdated or not well-maintained. The library is there, but don't expect it to be super stocked. Wi-Fi works sometimes. The campus looks fine overall, but maintenance could be better. Hostels are livable but basic; don't go in expecting luxury. Basical...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Apex University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average, it's like sufficient for you. The facility of the hostel is rated 4. Sometimes we don't get good food. The entry and exit timings of the hostel are not what I found suitable. The faculty members in the hostel are amazing. On a campus, there are clean classrooms with all relevant resources available.

reviews.review_heading: I think the college is value for money. The campus life is amazing. It has average placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good. It has playgrounds and good food at average fees. It also has AC facilities, laundry, and good infrastructure. I think the best part of the hostel is friends. In college, there are hostel students from every state of India. Warden's behavior is also good. Classrooms have smart boards.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure but not many job opportunities are offered.
reviews.review_text: The college has a nice infrastructure. All outdoor and indoor facilities related to curriculum and other activities and overall building are nice. Related to other colleges if you are a sports person then a perfect choice for you to play games like volleyball and football.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I can say that, take admission in it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good and modern. All courses like Designing, B.A., B.Com., etc., are available. There is good Wi-Fi in the library. The mess and canteen are hygienic. There are computer labs and biological or medical labs, with all the necessary equipment. All medical facilities are available in the lab. The sports activities are performed every week.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to start bachelor courses.
reviews.review_text: College campus is full of facilities. There are hostel facilities available, where students get Wi-Fi access, food, gym, etc. On campus, canteen, Wi-Fi, sports, and all facilities are available. The quality of food in the hostel mess is delicious.

reviews.review_heading: It is very good in my area. It helps to understand the situation and explain it.
reviews.review_text: It was the best course. College hostel had the best facilities. Good quality facilities were provided in our hostel. The quality of food available in the mess was the best. Canteen and medical facilities were available. Sports, games, and daily activities were conducted in our college. Wi-Fi and labs were very good.

reviews.review_heading: Many students got placed in infrastructure companies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in our university on every floor. Labs are good and maintained in our university. Classrooms are neat and clean. The library is very good and every book is available in the library. It has good quality food. It has safety, good food, and all facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I liked college.
reviews.review_text: Institute had well-equipped, Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, modern labs, and a well-stocked library. Mess of the hostel had decent food, and the hostel had a clean room with good security. Medical facilities were available around the clock, and sports infrastructure was adequate playgrounds and gym facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a dream college.
reviews.review_text: The library is available, and each floor has personal Wi-Fi available. The food quality is better than PG, I think, and the hostel faculty is too supportive. Medical facilities are also available. Sports are also an important priority given by my college. This is a dream college for me.

reviews.review_heading: Really a good faculty team, but average level of infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are at an average level, with an average level of lab infrastructure. In the computer lab, hardly 15 of the computers are working, and the rest are old, only to show off the greatness of the labs. I am not in the hostel, but when I talk to my hostel friends, they share quite a dull response towards the hostel.

review_summary.college_name: DRIEMS University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is really good.

content.Placements: As a current second-year student, I can speak about the overall placement reputation and what we hear from the senior batch. The placement cell is actively working, and the general sentiment is positive. The placement rate for the BBA graduation batch is typically around 60-70 percent. The highest package secured by a BBA graduate is 4 LPA. The average package generally falls between 3.0 and 3.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at DRIEMS is genuinely good and is one of the university's strong points. The campus is spacious and well-maintained. The BBA department has access to standard classrooms. The common computer labs are sufficient for our academic needs. The central library is well-stocked with essential management and commerce texts. It provides a quiet environment for studying. I appreciate, especially as I focus on maintaining a high CGPA.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and faculty are good, but less competitive in study and academics.

content.Placements: Only the top 10% to 20% of students of the batch get jobs at average positions. The highest package offered is around 6 LPA-7 LPA for MBA and UG courses like BBA and BCA, it's not known. Top and continued recruiters in our college are some back and financial institutions. Internships you can get through college also you are on that level and up to the mark, you can also apply by yourself by improving your knowledge, presence, and skills.
content.Infrastructure: Every type of facility is available such as labs, classrooms, and a big and maintained library. I don't live in the hostel but I know about it from my friends, in hostel the room quality is good enough to stay and about food, it is quite decent, not bad and it's 3 times menu. A very big medical is also available on the college campus which is Padmini Care which is owned by DRIEMS University. And other facilities like sports lab, ground, and everything are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: In our college, teachers, infrastructure, and facilities, but placements are average.

content.Placements: In our college, 40-50% of students got placed in our course. The highest package is 6 LPA. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Consultancy Services, ARC, Product IT, ESSPL, etc. 20-30% of students got internships in DRDO, Baleswar, etc. Some students are doing paid internships and some in startup companies.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, our faculty members are good. Our department is so beautiful and amazing. In our department, Wi-Fi is not available for students but ethernet will be provided in labs. Our library is awesome. Our hostel is good. In the hostel, Wi-Fi is available, but the network is very slow. The food quality is normal. Sports facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Unveiling the Driems University Experience: Pros and Cons.

content.Placements: A maximum of 600 hundred-plus students enrolled in the course in Bachelor of Technology. The maximum package was 8 LPA, and the average package was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Capgemini, TCS, Prodex, Tech Mahindra, Infotech, and Somya. The top roles offered are in full-stack web development and data analysis, with some including in frontend and Python development also.
content.Infrastructure: Well-equipped infrastructure and technology are available in every lab and classroom. They are well-designed, and every classroom has a projector or smart board. Faculty members are well-educated, and everyone is doing a Ph.D. A canteen is available behind the hostel, and the food is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in previous year batches.

content.Placements: Around 50-60% of students get placed every year in our college. The highest salary package offered in our college is around 8 LPA - 10 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. The average salary package offered is around 5 LPA - 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies in our college are TCS, HP, Deloitte, Wipro, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are good. Labs are available for every class. A library is also available in our college. Different departments are available for every course. The hostel of the college is also good. The mess quality is good.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in DRIEMS University?
faqs.answer: Admissions for various UG and PG courses at DRIEMS University in 2024 are based on either merit or entrance exams. If you want to apply for the flagship BTech courses, you can apply using your JEE Main/OJEE scores to get shortlisted for further rounds. Check below for the completeDRIEMS admission process:Application Process:To apply for DRIEMS University, you can either visit the official website and apply online or visit the university campus and purchase the application form from the admission office. Both online and offline modes are available.Selection Rounds:Once you have applied, you will need to appear for the relevant entrance exam as per the selection criteria of the chosen course. After that, you will need to wait for the release of the results.Admission Confirmation:If you are shortlisted based on your results, you will be called for document verification. You will then need to pay a course fee to confirm your seat in the university.

faqs.question: What are the courses that DRIEMS University offers?
faqs.answer: DRIEMS offers more than fifteen courses with various sub-specialisations. The courses are offered at undergraduate, postgraduate, Diploma and doctoral levels. The admission criteria for DRIEMS University courses is either merit-based or entrance-based. This institute is known for its four-year, full-time flagship BTech programme that offers admission based on the performance of the candidate in JEE Main/ OJEE. reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at DRIEMS is genuinely good and is one of the university's strong points. The campus is spacious and well-maintained. The BBA department has access to standard classrooms. The common computer labs are sufficient for our academic needs. The central library is well-stocked with essential management and commerce texts. It provides a quiet environment for studying. I appreciate, especially as I focus on maintaining a high CGPA.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and faculty are good, but less competitive in study and academics.
reviews.review_text: Every type of facility is available such as labs, classrooms, and a big and maintained library. I don't live in the hostel but I know about it from my friends, in hostel the room quality is good enough to stay and about food, it is quite decent, not bad and it's 3 times menu. A very big medical is also available on the college campus which is Padmini Care which is owned by DRIEMS University. And other facilities like sports lab, ground, and everything are available.

reviews.review_heading: In our college, teachers, infrastructure, and facilities, but placements are average.
reviews.review_text: In our college, our faculty members are good. Our department is so beautiful and amazing. In our department, Wi-Fi is not available for students but ethernet will be provided in labs. Our library is awesome. Our hostel is good. In the hostel, Wi-Fi is available, but the network is very slow. The food quality is normal. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Unveiling the Driems University Experience: Pros and Cons.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped infrastructure and technology are available in every lab and classroom. They are well-designed, and every classroom has a projector or smart board. Faculty members are well-educated, and everyone is doing a Ph.D. A canteen is available behind the hostel, and the food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in previous year batches.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are good. Labs are available for every class. A library is also available in our college. Different departments are available for every course. The hostel of the college is also good. The mess quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied. Faculty members are very good and well-behaved and eco-friendly.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is better across the whole campus, also in classes. Labs are well-maintained and air-conditioned. We have library period every week, and on other free days, you can also go to the library, which helps in studying. In the hostel, the facilities are much better, and the food is also better.

reviews.review_heading: University with Good Surroundings, Good Faculty Members, and Good Facilities.
reviews.review_text: AC labs with all technical facilities such as Wi-Fi, highly performing systems with the latest technology. AC is not provided in the classrooms, but a sufficient number of fans and lights are there. Also, good quality desks and benches with smart class systems such as projectors, greenboards, whiteboards, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely Satisfied with Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our department is very poor. There is only one lab for the entire department, with 30 computers, and many computers don't work properly. The classroom for us is the lab; there is no specific classroom for us. But the library is pretty good. I am not from the hostel, but from what I hear from the hostelers, the food is pretty bad.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good; no need to explain. You come here, and you will know everything.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course or department for Bachelor of Technology (BTech) students include computer labs with many computers. We have Wi-Fi in our hostel, and we have libraries, but they don't open for us, and if they do, they don't allow us access.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and green campus, well-structured and designed.
reviews.review_text: The environment is good, with a huge green campus that has a nature-friendly environment filled with gardens and plantations. The labs are well designed, but they could be upgraded because there isn't enough space for many students. The labs are fine and have working equipment.

reviews.review_heading: I have satisfied by the faculty's teaching experience. Good placement. Good facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are 15 faculty members who teach us, and they have good coordination with the students. There are 4 labs: one hardware lab and three software labs. The quality of food in the hostel is very good, and all the students are satisfied with the food. The college conducts sports every year.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a decent college, but they should focus more on skill development.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spread over 10 to 15 acres of land, with an eye-catching nature view and attractive buildings. The library and administrative building are must-visit places. The quality of hostel facilities is good, but the food is average. Aside from this, the medical, sports, and games facilities are top-notch.

reviews.review_heading: A very good environment to study and a very huge campus.
reviews.review_text: Classes are well maintained, but in class there is no Wi-Fi, but in the hostel Wi-Fi is available 24 hours a day. The library has so many collections of books. In hostel canteens, food is averagely good. So many types of sports are available, and gyms and swimming pools are available in college.

reviews.review_heading: A Real Description of My College: Driems University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The campus is full of trees and buses. The classrooms are equipped with fans, lights, and benches. The hostel is also decent, with four people in one room and a common almirah for two people, along with a common bathroom.

reviews.review_heading: DRIEMS University:  An overview and review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is very good having a large area of the campus and building blocks of each department are separated. The classrooms are of various types such as smart classrooms and normal classrooms. For each department, specific practical labs are available in good conditions.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college environment and student-friendly faculty.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am not happy with the guidelines of OU regarding assignments and projects.

reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The infrastructure is totally nice in our course. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. There is no dirty mess. On our campus, medical facilities are also provided. There are two grounds and a basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. B.C. Roy Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: College life is good. There is Wi-Fi, grounds, a gym, a chess club, and an entrepreneurship cell. The campus is very good. The hostel is good, with facilities for cricket and football. Labs and the 1st-year building are good.

reviews.review_heading: Dr. B.C. Roy Engineering College review.
reviews.review_text: My department has good basic infrastructure with Wi-Fi smart classrooms updated labs and a useful library. The hostel is comfortable with clean rooms and regular water and electricity. The mess food is average but the canteen has better options. Medical help is available on campus and the college also has facilities for sports like cricket football volleyball and indoor games. Overall the infrastructure is decent and supportive for students.

reviews.review_heading: Dr. B. C. Roy Engineering College is good for engineering and had good placements in 2019.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. The campus and buildings are good. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the college campus. The college hostel is available and of good quality.

In sports and games, we have a big playground, a basketball court, and a gym facility with good quality instruments and machines.

reviews.review_heading: To summarize-the college is good.

Canteens are also good and affordable. The good thing is you get Wi-Fi support all around the campus. They also have a library, which is good, but during exam session it feels crowded.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best private college in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very good, Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the college campus. In labs, AC is available, classrooms are very good, and the library is available.

reviews.review_heading: It has supportive faculty and extraordinary infrastructure. It is worth the investment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with CCTV and projectors. reviews.review_heading: In short, this college is good for every course.
reviews.review_text: On campus, everywhere Wi-Fi is available, labs are very good, classrooms are clean and good, and the library is excellent. The college campus is very good, with a college campus library available.
